$comment: Reusable precision audits. A spec lists one by id in `rubric.precision`, or writes its own inline. The judge lists every matching item on the site and labels it SUPPORTED, PLACEHOLDER, or UNSUPPORTED. Precision = supported / (supported + unsupported); placeholders are left out.

facts.items: factual claims: business or person names, contact details, addresses, hours, dates, times, prices, products, services, staff, reviews, testimonials, awards, and statistics
facts.supported: stated in the prompt (or its picker selections)
facts.unsupported: presented as real but not given in the prompt, or contradicting it
